measurements.R_mean_net: E28's net fixed change: (rho(m1) - rho(m0)) / rho_trig
measurements.R_key_net: per key k (the token at the trigger): (rho(m1_k) - rho(m0_k)) / rho_trig, m_k over training windows with key k, applied to held-out windows of key k
measurements.R_group_net: the same with 32 random groups instead of keys, mean of 5 draws: the size-matched null
measurements.R_strength: clip(p0(x) + a(x) s_p) / rho_trig in pre-activation space (g = clip(p)); a(x) = <d(x), s_p> / <s_p, s_p>, d = p1 - p0 at the trigger, s_p its training mean; alive subcomponents, all matrices
measurements.var_frac: share of d's variance across held-out windows (about its mean) along s_p
measurements.corr_a_logp: Pearson corr of a(x) with the original model's log-prob of the target on x
measurements.corr_rem_logp: Pearson corr over held-out windows of lo(own g1(x)) - lo(fixed m1) with the same log-prob
measurements.R_attn_fixed / R_attn_ref: attention matrices at m1 (ref: m0), MLP matrices at each window's own g1(x)
measurements.R_mlp_fixed / R_mlp_ref: MLP matrices at m1 (ref: m0), attention at g1(x)
measurements.R_steer: Gamma recomputed on W0's activations with each matrix's input at the trigger moved by the mean (updated - original) input over the training windows; R_steer_own: each window's own updated input at the trigger (the ceiling of trigger-only inputs)
measurements.pile: 32-key tasks: mean over keys of corr(s_k - mean s_k, c_k - mean c_k), c_k = W0's contrast at Pile ('val', 0, 600) positions holding key k (turned_down.contrasts), against 20 key derangements; control: the same with W0's per-key means m0_k in place of s_k
measurements.prev_token: reported only: s and s > 0.3 at (('h.1.attn.q_proj', 316), ('h.1.attn.k_proj', 329)); on the 32-key tasks the sd of s_k over keys
